title: 滩涂

series.next: Years later, a lawyer from 深圳 calls: someone has paid for your future. They won't say who.

setting: A fishing village on the 珠江 delta, 1998. Dusk on the mudflats. You're twelve.

stranger.name: 陌生人
stranger.en: a man with a chain on his ankle

steps.narr: 1998. A fishing village on the 珠江 delta. Dusk on the mudflats. You're twelve, and late home.
A hand closes on your arm. On his ankle: a chain.

say.en: Plead with him: don't hurt you, you won't tell.
answers: 别伤害我！我什么都不说。
求求你，别伤害我！我不喊。
say.gloss: Don't hurt me! I won't say anything.
say.tip: 伤害 shānghài = hurt, harm. 什么都不说 = say nothing at all.

answers: 别伤害我，我一个字都不说！
求你别伤害我，一个字都不说！
4.gloss: Don't hurt me. I won't say one word!
4.tip: 一个字都不说 = not say a single word.

steps.en: I haven't eaten in three days.

steps.zh: 天亮之前，给我拿吃的，还有钳子。
steps.en: Before dawn, bring me food. And pliers.

steps.zh: 我不是一个人。外面还有人。
steps.en: I'm not alone. There are others out there.

say.en: Bargain: you'll fetch them, he waits here.
answers: 好，我去拿，你在这儿等着。
say.gloss: All right, I'll get them. You wait here.
say.tip: 等着 děngzhe = wait (there): 你在这儿等着.

ok.narr: He lets go. You run, all the way home.

answers: 你放开我，我去拿，天亮前回来。
你先放开我，我去拿，天亮回来。
4.gloss: Let go of me. I'll fetch them, and be back by dawn.

steps.en: Where have you been? This late!

steps.narr: While nobody's looking, you slip a 粽子 up your sleeve.

steps.zh: 桌上的粽子呢？少了一个。
steps.en: Where's the 粽子 that was on the table? There's one missing.

say.en: Lie: you ate it, you were starving.
say.gloss: I ate it... I was starving.
say.tip: 是我吃的 = it was me who ate it: 是……的 puts the weight on who.

answers: 舅妈，是我吃的，实在太饿了。
对不起，是我吃的，实在太饿了。
4.gloss: It was me. I was just so hungry.
4.tip: 实在 shízài = truly, really: 实在太饿了.

steps.narr: Night. Out on the water, the lights of the search boats, moving slowly.
Dawn. The mudflats. Food in one hand. In your pocket, 舅舅's pliers.

say.en: Give him the pliers too, or only the food.
say.tip: 钳子 qiánzi = pliers. ……也给你 = this as well, for you.

ok.narr: He takes the pliers, and goes into the mist.

then.narr: He eats as if he's forgotten how. Then he's gone into the mist.

answers: 钳子我也带来了，都给你。
我把钳子也带来了，给你。
4.gloss: I brought the pliers too. Take it all.

answers: 只有吃的，钳子是舅舅的。
只有吃的，钳子是我舅舅的。
alts.gloss: Just food. The pliers are my uncle's.

steps.en: That evening the boats find a broken chain on the mud. Nobody asks you a thing. ⛓️

else.en: That evening the boats go out again. You never learn if they found him. 🌫️
